mission: Derive privacy-bounded outcome evidence from natural usage and repository/provider/runtime observations, separate observed symptoms from candidate agent causes, quantify operator correction burden, and select a bounded recovery intervention without treating ordinary use as success or failure or granting mutation/promotion authority.

outcome_classes.routing: The wrong prompt, owner, workflow, lane, or mutation surface was selected.
outcome_classes.interpretation: The correct prompt/owner was selected but an explicit instruction, invariant, scope, or authority boundary was misunderstood or ignored.
outcome_classes.execution: The intended operation was understood and attempted, but implementation or action failed under otherwise available conditions.
outcome_classes.progression: Work repeats on the same mission without advancing durable evidence state.
outcome_classes.durability: Required state exists transiently or conversationally but not in the durable repository/provider artifact that should own it.
outcome_classes.premature-terminal: Work was classified terminal while safe actionable continuation remained.
outcome_classes.evidence-promotion: A stronger evidence state was claimed than current evidence proves.
outcome_classes.regression: Behavior previously proven against the same intended requirement later violates that requirement.
outcome_classes.environment: External provider, permission, credential, runtime, network, hardware, quota, or tooling conditions prevented otherwise-correct execution.
outcome_classes.unknown: Available evidence cannot safely distinguish success, failure, abandonment, or environmental effects.

cause_families.grounding: The task model starts from the wrong context, owner, source, or problem framing.
cause_families.intent-fidelity: The response/action drifts away from the user request on a one-to-one basis.
cause_families.decomposition: The mission is not compiled into a complete executable work graph, so required parts disappear or are handled serially without global state.
cause_families.contract-fidelity: The agent proceeds confidently while violating an explicit invariant, scope boundary, authority rule, or evidence contract.
cause_families.action-space: The agent prematurely narrows available actions, claims capability is unavailable, or misses an authorized workaround.
cause_families.recovery: Correction evidence is received but the underlying task model is not sufficiently rebased, causing repeated repair loops or restart pressure.
cause_families.unknown: Evidence is insufficient to name a candidate cause family.

rules.when: claimed evidence-state rank is stronger than observed evidence-state rank, or success is claimed across a proven unresolved blocker
terminal_claim and safe_successor_observed are both present for the same mission
a durable artifact is required and deterministically absent, or repeated manual context transfer reaches the durability threshold
the same intended requirement has prior validated evidence and later broken or reverted evidence
a replacement canonical owner advances the same task after the original route did not
an explicit invariant or requirement is present and later violated by the selected owner
deterministic action failure, false unavailable claim, or ignored available capability occurs without an external environment cause
same prompt/mission repeats at least the threshold without durable advance, or repeated correction is not integrated
an external provider/access/runtime/tooling failure is independently observed and no stronger prompt defect is proven
only ordinary usage, unreasoned dislike, healthy repeat use, or unobservable external execution is available

response_relevance.source: bounded local evaluator or explicit structured evaluation; ordinary usage alone cannot manufacture this score

steps: FREEZE_UNPROVEN_MUTATION: stop compounding the current inference path while preserving verified evidence.
REFRESH_DURABLE_TRUTH: reload canonical repository/provider/runtime state and current user constraints from authorized sources.
REBUILD_TASK_MODEL: reconstruct requested outcome, contracts, scope, complete work graph, available action surfaces, and current evidence state.
DIFF_ASSUMPTIONS: compare the prior task model with refreshed evidence; discard unsupported assumptions and retain only proven state.
REANCHOR_ONE_TO_ONE: bind the next response/action to the exact current user request and its completion gate before adding extra work.
RESUME_SMALLEST_SAFE_ACTION: execute one dependency-ready action and require durable evidence advance.

ESCALATE_ON_RECURRENCE: if the same cause recurs after REGROUND, REBOOTSTRAP from durable truth and emit a minimal fresh-session handoff only when the runtime cannot clear contaminated context in place.
grounding_recovery_protocol.completion_gate: A post-recovery pass advances durable evidence without repeating the triggering correction pattern; otherwise escalate one intervention level.
